      A fresh set. Whenever you want.

      The rules

      A word at a time.

      1. Use every letter to make a word. Tap the tiles or type. Valid alternative anagrams count.
      2. You get 30 seconds per word. Unused seconds don’t carry over.
      3. Use the Shuffle button once per word. Tap a selected letter to erase from its last occurrence onward. Backspace removes the last letter; Clear removes all.
      4. Miss a word? We’ll reveal the answer and move on. Your score is how many you solve out of 20.
      THE SAME CLIMB, EVERY TIME

      2 × 4 letters → 5 × 5 → 6 × 6 → 3 × 7 → 2 × 8 → 1 × 9 → 1 × 10

      Switching apps pauses the game. Reloading starts a fresh session.

      About this game

      More room for wordplay.

      20 words is an independent anagram game with unlimited play. A new set of twenty words is chosen at the start of every game. Repeated words are possible.

      Puzzles use a smaller word list. A broader dictionary still accepts less-common anagrams and different English spellings using your letters.

      Words from SCOWL.
